cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Enables AI Agent Shopping
cards.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet now allows AI agents to shop and checkout on users' behalf. Limited rollout began with U.S. Pro subscribers.

cards.title: LangChain Reaches $3B Valuation Milestone
cards.body: AI agent startup LangChain achieved unicorn status with its model-agnostic LangSmith platform. The company now serves 7,000 customers across enterprises.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Meeting Notetaker
cards.body: ElevenAI combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams and enterprises. The new app targets collaborative workplace AI adoption.

cards.title: Google Search Upgraded With Gemini 4
cards.body: Google's AI Mode now understands complex queries better with Gemini 4 Hydrogen powering improved search results. The update delivers richer visual responses and relevant link surfacing.

cards.title: Nectar AI Automates Influencer Marketing
cards.body: Nectar's new AI agent automates creator discovery and brand partnerships. The platform streamlines outreach management and campaign tracking for marketers.

cards.title: Muse AI Places Outbound Calls
cards.body: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses with a paid subscription. The feature expands AI agent capabilities for business outreach.

cards.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agent Bookings
cards.body: United Airlines prohibits AI agents from booking flights citing cybersecurity risks. The decision restricts customer use of AI for reservation management.

cards.title: Phota Labs Automates Professional Photo Editing
cards.body: Phota Labs uses AI to transform everyday photos into professional-quality shots automatically. The tool simplifies editing for non-experts without manual adjustment.

cards.title: Nebius Secures $40B AI Infrastructure Funding
cards.body: Nebius plans $40 billion in AI infrastructure expansion via customer prepayments and loans. The neocloud model faces scrutiny amid Microsoft data center delays.

cards.title: China Trained Advanced AI on Banned Chips
cards.body: Research reveals China's most powerful AI models were trained using export-banned Nvidia chips. The discovery raises national security concerns in the U.S.-China AI race.

cards.title: Silicon Valley's AI Leaders Miss Midterm Predictions
cards.body: Tech visionaries like OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk claim to predict the future, yet failed to anticipate midterm election outcomes. Their long-term vision strategies don't always translate to accurate forecasting.

cards.title: Nvidia Confirms Chip-Tracking Technology Feasibility
cards.body: Nvidia privately told Congress it could technically implement anti-smuggling measures in the Chip Security Act. The company's confirmation contradicts public industry claims that such tracking is infeasible.

cards.title: FAA Expands AI for US Air Traffic Management
cards.body: The FAA is rolling out AI-powered systems to manage congestion across the entire US airspace. This expansion aims to improve efficiency and reduce delays nationwide.

cards.title: OpenAI Board Member Warns of AI Takeover Risk
cards.body: An OpenAI board member raised concerns that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning highlights growing anxieties about rapid AI advancement and control.

cards.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model
cards.body: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing the older 3.8 Flash model. The new AI model represents the company's continued iteration on large language models.

cards.title: Google Faces School AI Moratorium Calls
cards.body: Schools are demanding AI moratoriums after backlash against Google's Gemini pilot program. Educators express concerns about AI integration in educational settings.

cards.title: Data Centers Face Power Supply Crisis
cards.body: Data center expansion across the US is creating electricity bottlenecks, particularly in regions like Ashburn, Virginia. The backlash against data centers centers on rising power demands and grid strain.
